_why: Verified mfr+productId COUPLES (Z2M/ZHA) with a fixed driver. The gate fails if the exact couple (mfr in manufacturerName AND pid in productId, case-insensitive) is claimed by any other driver, or missing from its pinned driver. Other pids of the same mfr are not covered. Gate: tools/ci/couple-pin-gate.js
